Hasil Backtest & Loop Engineering: Strategi Momentum

Dataset Real-Time 262 Trade Momentum (20 Okt 23:10 WIB – 21 Okt 14:00 WIB) · Stake $5.00 · Friction 2.5%

Kesimpulan Utama Hasil Engineering:
1. Akar Masalah Baseline: Baseline rugi akibat Stop Loss terlalu longgar (-10%) dan ketiadaan filter volume, di mana trade dengan Buy Share <50% menyumbang rugi terbesar.
2. Logika Paling Menguntungkan: Strategi Golden Sweet-Spot Runner (Mcap ≥ $20k, Buyers ≥ 12, BuyShare ≥ 65% + SL 5%, TP 30%, Trail 10%/-2%) menghasilkan Win Rate 69.8% dan Profit Factor 5.76.
3. Opsi Volume Tinggi: Jika ingin tetap mengambil banyak trade (148 trade), Strategy 6 / F4 menghasilkan +$56.72 Net PnL (WR 66.9%, PF 4.56).
